adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `updateAllCalendarEvents` was changed to handle multiple calendar references (`calendarReference` is now an array) and now loops `for (const reference of calendarReference)`. Inside that loop, when `reference.credentialId` is set but not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it does an `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } ... })` (newly added). Because this `await` is inside the loop, multiple references will trigger multiple DB round-trips serially (a classic N+1/performance pattern). Batching referenced credential IDs up front (or parallelizing) would avoid this.
